messages:
anya: Nightly eval alert: sharp jump in hallucination rate for the finance-kbqa promptset at 00:00 UTC. AUC dropped from 0.92 -> 0.74, hallucinations up ~5x.

anya: plot + diffs: https://internal/plots/3187654321 (samples + calibration histograms).

vivek: ok can you paste one or two examples?

anya: example 1:
User: 'What's Redwood's revenue in 2023?'
Model (canary): 'Redwood reported $1.2B in 2023...' <- fabricated, no citation.
Model (baseline): 'We don't have public revenue numbers. See internal finance doc.'

kim: when did this start? recent deploy?

anya: correlates with last night's quant pipeline tweak (per-channel LN folding + bf16 preconvert) merged by sara at 23:15 UTC.

sara: yep i merged PR #5123 to speed up per-channel quant calibration. config diff:
```
- quant: {mode: ptq, per_channel: false}
+ quant: {mode: ptq, per_channel: true}
+ preconvert_dtype: bf16
```

vivek: could preconverting to bf16 before calibration shift the stats used for folding? that might change layernorm scales.

kim: I ran a quick synth reg comparison: outputs diverged after the fold for long contexts (>1k tokens) and for numeric/citation answers.

anya: root-cause hypothesis: layernorm folding + bf16 preconvert changed the scale of softmax inputs on the long-context kernels, shifting the output distribution and increasing hallucination on knowledge-grounded prompts.

sara: rolling back the merge now to revert per_channel:false and remove preconvert flag. starting canary rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollback quant-pipeline @sara -> canary group 'nightly' 1%.

ops-oncall: adding gating rule: block quant pipeline changes unless nightly eval passes (hallucination AUC delta <= 0.02) AND 48h staged canary.

vivek: short-term mitigation: revert live canary to baseline model for hosted API, and enforce fallback on high-stakes routes (finance/*, legal/*).

anya: action items:
- sara: rollback PR fully + attach calibration logs + per-layer histograms (ETA 2h)
- vivek: add regression test for finance-kbqa promptset + numeric-citation checks (ETA EOD)
- kim: run full nightly with revert and post results (ETA next run)
- ops-oncall: add CI gating rule + blocklist for preconvert flags (ETA 24h)

sara: done with rollback and PR revert: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5140

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 23:42 UTC. Canary metrics converging back to baseline.

anya: next nightly shows AUC back to 0.91. tagging for postmortem and adding requirement: any preconvert dtype or LN-fold change must be validated on long-context + knowledge-grounded evals before merge.

kim: let's schedule a short postmortem tomorrow and keep the temporary gating rule until quant changes run through staged canaries.

sara: noted. sorry for the noise, will include calibration histograms and a long-context suite in follow-ups.

anya: thanks all :heart:
